note: Auth page: personal V2 API tokens sent in the Authorization header; 'create a free developer account to get an API token'. App OAuth flow (authorization code, scopes, bearer access tokens that do not expire, no refresh tokens) is documented. The OAuth page says an admin may need to install the app in an account (force_install_if_needed), and the app marketplace has a review checklist; I did not confirm whether review is required for multi-tenant OAuth use, so blocker could arguably be app_review or admin_install. Official platform MCP documented in the API docs sidebar (token and own-OAuth-app auth). API is GraphQL only (api.monday.com/v2).
